COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates), its organization/presentation (coordinate listing), and a separate origin/status field are all explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation statement linking processing or allocation to the identified content's organization or access.

C.rationale: The text identifies specific content (red) and its coordinates for a named referent/time.

D.rationale: The report separately lists content (red coordinates) and a status/origin field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The coordinate listing states how the content is represented/presented (organized pattern) for the named referent/time.
